title: Love it
body:
MUST. FILL. BOXES.
Easy to use, design is lovely and simple. I have ADHD and I have tried other habit tracker apps but hey didn’t stick with me. The visual of filling boxes makes me more motivated consistent. As if a game I don’t want my chain of boxes to get broken. 
I was going to recommend a feature but I saw developer already listed it as incoming, this informing and communicative attitude was a huge plus for me.
author: Samuraixoxo

title: Simple and Useful
body: It has a monthly and yearly calendar view that I couldn’t find in other apps, and I love it. Please don’t remove the monthly and yearly calendar view feature. :) It has a simple and very user-friendly interface. There are some areas that could be improved, and they’re already on the “in progress” list. I hope those updates come soon. Highly recommended.
author: Happyuser78

title: Cool!
body: I am really enjoy this app, tracking all my habits. I would like to see more flexibility, so I can “skip” a habit when i am not able to do it, for example, i am sick and cannot swim or jogging. Meanwhile i dont want to loose my results
author: mazohsister
